6. The present appeal has been filed by the Appellant, who is the prosecutrix, under Section 413 of the B.N.S.S. read with Section 378 of Cr.P.C. challenging the impugned judgment dated 10th December, 2025 passed by the ld.

Additional Sessions Judge FTSC (POCSO)-01, Central District,
Delhi in Sessions Case no. 473/2022 arising out of FIR No. 163/22 registered at P.S. Gulabi Bagh for offences punishable under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter, 'IPC') and Sections 6/21 of the Protection of Children from Sexual offences Act, 2012 (hereinafter, 'POCSO Act').

sentences.text: Vide the impugned judgment, the Trial Court has acquitted the father of the prosecutrix for offences punishable under Section 376(2)(k), 376(2)(n), Section 376(3) of IPC and Section 506 of IPC as also Section 6 of POCSO Act, and mother of the prosecutrix for offences punishable under Section 21 of the POCSO Act.
8. The allegations made by the prosecutrix were that her father would repeatedly rape her and when she informed this fact to her mother, no action was taken by her.
Thereafter, the prosecutrix was married.
However, even after her marriage, when she had visited her parental home, she is alleged to have been raped by her father.

9. The Trial Court has acquitted the parents of the prosecutrix on the ground that there was a delay in filing the complaint and there were certain inconsistencies in the testimony of the prosecutrix.
